_what: Fingerprints are keyed by stable release source path, independent of deployed destination. Legacy Claude paths contribute historical hashes to their portable source key. Read only to migrate a harness that has no installed-file receipt: a destination whose fingerprint is not listed under its source key is not recognised as Orion's and is preserved. Historical legacy refresh keys remain in this registry for clients still on a same-path updater, although the retired .claude skill sources are no longer in the refresh list. Contract: update/manifest.json deployment and agent/updating.md.
_fingerprint: SHA-256, as lowercase hex, of the file read as UTF-8 text with every CRLF turned into LF.
_frozen: Frozen compatibility data for harnesses installed before installed-file receipts. Never regenerated from git history and never extended with the bytes of a release edit. update/release-contract.mjs validates its structure and that every retirement identity and legacy alias in update/manifest.json is listed. It lists only versions a client could have installed (files in a first-parent commit of main or release/2.0.0), and no versions of itself: updates read only the incoming release's copy, so a harness's copy is bookkeeping, replaced whatever its bytes.
